name: Helix
text: A modal text editor with multiple selections and syntax trees built in. Edits files in its own home.

name: micro
text: A terminal text editor with the keys people already know: Ctrl-S saves, Ctrl-Q quits.

name: Kakoune
text: A modal editor where you select first and act second. Runs shell snippets, so it may run other programs.

name: Vim
text: The classic modal editor, with its full runtime of syntax files and plugins.

name: bat
text: cat with syntax highlighting and line numbers. Runs a pager for long files.

name: eza
text: A modern ls: colours, file types, trees and long listings.

name: nnn
text: A tiny, fast file manager. Opens files in other programs.

name: ncdu
text: See what takes the space in a directory tree, and clean it up.

name: fzf
text: A fuzzy finder for files, lines and anything else piped into it.

name: Git
text: Version control. Clones and fetches over Nym or Anyone, never directly, from any remote you name.

name: tig
text: A text interface for browsing a Git repository's history. Runs git.

name: lazygit
text: A terminal interface for Git: stage, commit, branch and rebase with a few keys. Runs git.

name: age
text: Simple, modern file encryption with small explicit keys. Works offline.

name: minisign
text: Sign files and verify signatures, offline, with tiny Ed25519 keys.

name: FLAC
text: Encode and decode lossless FLAC audio files.

name: Geth (dev chain)
text: go-ethereum for local development: geth --dev runs a private chain on this machine with its console. It cannot sync a public network here, and has no network.
